text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
The Lord answer you in the day of trouble! The name of the God of Jacob protect you!
text_cn: 愿上主在忧患之日，俯允你， 愿雅各伯天主的名，保佑你！

text_en: May he send you help from the sanctuary, and give you support from Zion.
text_cn: 愿他从圣所救护你， 愿他由熙雍扶助你！

text_en: May he remember all your offerings, and regard with favor your burnt sacrifices. Selah
text_cn: 愿他追念你的一切祭献， 愿他悦纳你的全燔祭献！ （休止）

text_en: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your plans.
text_cn: 愿他满全你心中的志愿， 愿他玉成你的一切筹算！

text_en: May we shout for joy over your victory, and in the name of our God set up our banners. May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
text_cn: 我们要因你的胜利而欢舞， 奉我们天主的名竖立旗鼓： 你的一切请求，愿上主成就！

text_en: Now I know that the Lord will help his anointed; he will answer him from his holy heaven with mighty victories by his right hand.
text_cn: 我深信上主必赏他的受傅者获胜， 以无敌右手救拯，从神圣高天俯听。

text_en: Some take pride in chariots, and some in horses, but our pride is in the name of the Lord our God.
text_cn: 他们或仗恃战车，他们或仗恃战马； 我们只以上主，我们天主的名自夸。

text_en: They will collapse and fall, but we shall rise and stand upright.
text_cn: 他们必将倒地丧命。 我们却将挺身立定。

text_en: Give victory to the king, O Lord ; answer us when we call.
text_cn: 上主，求你赐予君王获胜， 我们求你时，请俯允我们。
